findings.title: Critical production state stored in ephemeral in-memory stores
findings.currentReality: Experiment E, visual development runs, project intelligence manifests, and visual reference memory use process-local memory stores with no Supabase persistence. Railway API restart or multi-instance deployment loses all run state.
findings.expectedReality: Founder-triggered creative runs, proofs, manifests, and experiment progress persist durably per project with resume-safe retrieval.
findings.whyItMatters: The system cannot be operationally trustworthy if approved proofs, formation receipts, and intelligence manifests vanish on deploy.
findings.failureMode: Founder forms concepts, approves design proof, redeploys API → all state gone; appears as blank experiment or re-prompt to pay/regenerate.
findings.userImpact: Lost founder judgments, duplicate spend, broken lineage, distrust in Studio World memory.
findings.methodologyImpact: Experimental integrity and provenance chains break at the persistence boundary.
findings.whatItBlocks: PRODUCTION_READY for Experience Expression, Visual Development, Project Intelligence
findings.recommendedCorrection: Migrate Experiment E, visual development, project intelligence, and visual reference stores to Supabase JSONB runs table pattern used by methodology_validation_runs / creative lineage.
dependencies: storeAdapter parity with Experiment D/F pattern

findings.title: Composer implementation orchestration is a stub
findings.currentReality: orchestrateVisualDevelopmentImplementation() validates contract then returns orchestrationPackageId string only — no Composer dispatch, no file targets, no webhook.
findings.expectedReality: APPROVED PROOF → PREPARE IMPLEMENTATION → ORCHESTRATE dispatches structured package to Composer/Cursor with assets, contract, acceptance criteria.
findings.whyItMatters: Visual-development-before-implementation methodology stops at contract compilation; human must manually bridge to code.
findings.failureMode: Founder clicks ORCHESTRATE IMPLEMENTATION → receives ID → no code changes → false sense of pipeline completion.
findings.userImpact: Manual copy/paste handoff; implementation drift from approved proof.
findings.methodologyImpact: Breaks GRAPHIC→PAGE product chain at implementation boundary.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Define OrchestrationDispatchAdapter (webhook/API) consuming implementation contract + asset URLs; persist dispatch receipt.

findings.title: Implementation fidelity evaluation never evaluates
findings.currentReality: evaluateExperienceImplementation() returns NOT_EVALUATED for all dimensions unless renderedEvidence supplied; no live screenshot comparison pipeline wired.
findings.expectedReality: Post-implementation capture compares approved proof vs live page with semantic/asset/layout dimensions and actionable deltas.
findings.whyItMatters: Cannot close the fidelity loop promised by visual-development methodology.
findings.failureMode: Implementation ships with generic dashboard drift undetected.
findings.userImpact: Founder discovers mismatch only by manual visual inspection.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Wire captureService to post-implementation routes; vision-model or structured DOM diff; feed revisionDelta generator.

findings.title: motherboard/MEMORY.md contains unresolved merge conflict
findings.currentReality: MEMORY.md lines 3554-3609 contain <<<<<<< HEAD conflict markers on main branch.
findings.expectedReality: Single append-only MEMORY timeline without conflict markers.
findings.whyItMatters: Agent auto-load reads corrupted context; future agents may misparse project state.
findings.failureMode: Agents skip or misinterpret recent sprints.
findings.userImpact: Inconsistent agent behavior across sessions.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Resolve conflict preserving both entries in chronological order.

findings.title: NDXBOOK-only hardcoding blocks multi-client scale
findings.currentReality: Most creative experiment and formation API actions in projects.ts gate slug === 'ndxbook'. Commercial state defaults ndxbook/frontal-slayer to ACTIVATED.
findings.expectedReality: Project-scoped experiments and intelligence keyed by organization/project with isolation guards.
findings.whyItMatters: Architecture claims brand-agnostic Studio World but runtime is NDXBOOK pilot shell.
findings.failureMode: Second client cannot run experiments; intelligence manifest faked complete for ndxbook only.
findings.userImpact: Frontal Slayer / AIO cannot use same pipelines without fork.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Parameterize experiment registry by projectId; remove legacy COMPLETE shortcuts except explicit migration records.

findings.title: False readiness: 1508 tests mostly mock provider and memory paths
findings.currentReality: FAL, Anthropic, Playwright, and Supabase often short-circuit under VITEST or missing keys. Tests assert constants, gates, and mock success paths.
findings.expectedReality: Separate LIVE_VERIFICATION checklist distinct from unit PASS; production smoke tests for critical pipelines.
findings.whyItMatters: PASS in CI ≠ production verified — exactly the false readiness this audit targets.
findings.failureMode: Deploy to Railway without FAL_KEY/Playwright → silent failures or empty state while tests green.
findings.userImpact: Founder triggers generation → error or mock behavior in dev.
findings.methodologyImpact: Experiment conclusions may be test-harness artifacts.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Add audit/live-verification-gaps registry; optional staged live smoke (founder-triggered) with receipts.

findings.title: Reference-conditioned generation never live-verified end-to-end
findings.currentReality: Architecture compiles VisualReferencePackage, selects edit model, passes image_urls via buildFalImageInput — but no recorded production run proving strict host conditioning works.
findings.expectedReality: At least one founder-triggered reference-conditioned proof with receipt, reference IDs, and adherence QA stored.
findings.whyItMatters: Core fix for generic AI creative drift unproven in production.
findings.failureMode: Prompt says strict reference but model ignores or FAL edit fails → fallback blocked or generic T2I.
findings.userImpact: Projects UX proof may still look generic sci-fi.
findings.methodologyImpact: Visual Reference Intelligence remains INTEGRATED not LIVE_PATH_VERIFIED.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Founder-triggered live smoke with stored receipt; fail loudly if edit model unavailable.

findings.title: Playwright capture depends on environment not validated on Railway
findings.currentReality: captureService dynamically imports playwright; failures return incomplete capture. No CI/Railway proof of browser binaries, auth session for protected routes, or font load waits.
findings.expectedReality: Capture manifest records success/failure per route with deployment commit; authenticated capture strategy documented and tested.
findings.whyItMatters: Automated visual reference intelligence requires reliable capture in API runtime.
findings.failureMode: Refresh references → empty Host Visual Memory → reference-conditioned gen fails or degrades to text-only.
findings.userImpact: Founder must manually screenshot despite methodology saying otherwise.
findings.methodologyImpact: Host/client visual separation collapses to prose canon.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Dedicated capture worker or Railway buildpack with Playwright; capture health endpoint.

findings.title: No unified execution telemetry (StudioWorldRunRecord)
findings.currentReality: Generation receipts scattered across formation receipts, FAL results, replay execution, methodology_validation_runs JSONB — no single query for 'what is running, what failed, what cost'.
findings.expectedReality: Unified run record linking project, experiment, provider, prompt fingerprint, cost, status, supersession.
evidence: Per-service accounting fields in experiment runs
findings.whyItMatters: Founder cannot operate sophisticated system without becoming DBA; failures hard to diagnose.
findings.failureMode: Duplicate generation, untracked spend, unknown failure reason.
findings.userImpact: Opaque 'FAILED' buttons.
findings.methodologyImpact: Cost governance and idempotency auditing weakened.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Lightweight run ledger table + append-only events; unify existing receipts via adapter.

findings.title: Concept Territory V2 set evaluation is deterministic local, not model-audited
findings.currentReality: runConceptOrthogonalityEvaluationV2 uses token overlap heuristics and regex parent-collapse patterns. Sonnet forms concepts but does not audit set orthogonality.
findings.expectedReality: Hybrid: deterministic gates + optional Sonnet auditor for borderline sets; clear NEEDS_REFORMATION reasons.
findings.whyItMatters: Experiment F may PASS heuristic checks while still direction-level clustering (Experiment D lesson).
findings.failureMode: False PASS → founder review burden; or false NEEDS_REFORMATION → unnecessary reform spend.
findings.userImpact: Wrong six concepts advance or excessive Sonnet reform cycles.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Add optional Sonnet set auditor with frozen prompt version; calibrate heuristics against Experiment D negative evidence.

findings.title: CODEBASE.md and docs severely stale vs implementation
findings.currentReality: CODEBASE.md last updated 2026-08-18; omits shared/site00-brand-lore, experiments, visual reference, project intelligence, 78 projects.ts actions.
findings.expectedReality: Current codebase snapshot or generated SYSTEM MAP for agents.
findings.whyItMatters: Agents and founders rely on wrong structural map.
findings.failureMode: Duplicate systems, missed integration points.
findings.userImpact: Slower development, wrong assumptions.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Snapshot codebase to motherboard; add minimal audit/SYSTEM_MAP.md.

findings.title: Product Expression methodology absent
findings.currentReality: Experience Expression covers surfaces/pages; Application modules in intake exist but no PRODUCT_EXPRESSION layer for loops, roles, persistent state, notifications.
findings.expectedReality: Formal PRODUCT_EXPRESSION between Experience and World for SaaS/app behavior.
findings.whyItMatters: Roadmap GRAPHIC→PAGE→PRODUCT→WORLD skips formal product layer.
findings.failureMode: App projects reuse experience/page metaphors incorrectly.
findings.userImpact: Ambiguous deliverables for Application scope.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Design PRODUCT_EXPRESSION contract (roles, loops, state) — do not implement until Experience pipeline trustworthy.

findings.title: World Formation contracts deep but runtime-absent (correct) — several future blockers unnamed
findings.currentReality: worldFormation/futureContracts.ts extensive schemas; WORLD_FORMATION_IMPLEMENTED false. Missing: session/presence model, economy/inventory, UGC moderation, live event sync, asset streaming, world version migration.
findings.expectedReality: Contracts acknowledge realtime, legal, concurrency domains before research spend.
findings.whyItMatters: SELECT WORLD tier could become expensive immersive site without true world discipline.
findings.failureMode: Premature 3D/multiplayer build on page architecture.
findings.userImpact: Cost overruns, non-viable worlds.
findings.methodologyImpact: World vs immersive site boundary blur.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Add WorldFormationReadinessBlockers doc section: presence, economy, moderation, sync.

findings.title: Multi-user concurrency and approval races unaddressed
findings.currentReality: Founder-centric judgments, no optimistic locking on run JSONB, no reviewer roles.
findings.expectedReality: Judgment/version conflicts detected; role-scoped gates.
evidence: Founder judgment services without concurrency tokens
findings.whyItMatters: 100 clients or team members → conflicting approvals and lost updates.
findings.failureMode: Two tabs approve different proofs; last write wins.
findings.userImpact: Disputed approvals.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Run version field + conflict errors; roadmap RBAC.

findings.title: AI provider payloads may include full brand intelligence without minimization policy
findings.currentReality: Formation prompts compile brand lore, personality, appetite into Anthropic payloads; no documented data-minimization or PII scrubbing layer.
findings.expectedReality: Explicit ProviderPayloadPolicy: what fields cross boundary per stage.
findings.whyItMatters: Client raw answers and business intelligence sent to third parties.
findings.failureMode: Over-sharing in prompts; compliance risk at scale.
findings.userImpact: Privacy exposure.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Payload compiler with field allowlist per provider role; audit log of sent categories not raw text.

findings.title: Experiment D integrity architecture sound; Experiment F store fallback silent
findings.currentReality: Experiment D overlay non-destructive; quarantine guards present. Experiment F falls back to memory if Supabase tables missing without founder-visible warning.
findings.expectedReality: Explicit store mode surfaced in API response; fail if production expects durable store.
findings.whyItMatters: Silent memory fallback mimics Experiment E failure mode.
findings.failureMode: Formation succeeds → lost on restart.
findings.userImpact: Re-form required after deploy.
findings.methodologyImpact: Blind formation integrity OK; persistence not.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Return storeMode in experiment_f_get; require Supabase in production.

findings.title: Discovery → intelligence separation implemented but commercial state partly simulated
findings.currentReality: intakeSynthesisGate blocks public lore synthesis; manifest compiler exists. getCommercialStateForProject shortcuts ndxbook/frontal-slayer to ACTIVATED.
findings.expectedReality: Commercial state from payment/provisioning records only.
findings.whyItMatters: False activation bypasses purchase boundary testing.
findings.failureMode: Unpaid paths reach post-purchase intelligence in pilot projects.
findings.userImpact: Commercial workflow untested for real checkout.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Feature-flag pilot shortcuts; separate PILOT_COMMERCIAL_OVERRIDE from production path.

findings.title: Project workspace three-layer model implemented in types; NDXBOOK visual assumptions in proof manifests
findings.currentReality: projectWorkspaceCanon, clientProjectExpressionProfile, colorOwnership exist with tests. designProofManifest hardcodes SITE00 projects index + NDXBOOK home proofs.
findings.expectedReality: Parameterized proof surfaces per client; workspace canon brand-agnostic.
findings.whyItMatters: Multi-client viability partially proven in tests only for hypothetical profiles.
findings.failureMode: Frontal Slayer project inherits NDXBOOK dossier aesthetic defaults.
findings.userImpact: Wrong brand expression on project pages.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Extract proof manifest templates per experience class; validate with FRONTAL SLAYER dry-run.

findings.title: No ProjectGenerationLedger — cost governance per project/package incomplete
findings.currentReality: Per-run accounting fields on experiments; EXPERIENCE_VISUAL_COST_ESTIMATE_USD constant; no rollup ledger or budget caps.
findings.expectedReality: Project-level ledger with founder triggers, estimates, actuals, budget exceeded errors.
findings.whyItMatters: Cannot measure package profitability or prevent runaway spend.
findings.failureMode: Retry loops multiply FAL cost unnoticed.
findings.userImpact: Surprise provider bills.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Append-only generation_ledger table; BUDGET_EXCEEDED error taxonomy.

findings.title: Generic-template detection substantive but not vision-verified
findings.currentReality: genericTemplateAudit.ts and designProofQA evaluate heuristics/keywords; no image-model generic detector in production path.
findings.expectedReality: Layered generic detection: heuristic + optional vision QA on proofs.
findings.whyItMatters: Generic AI creative remains key product risk.
findings.failureMode: Generic proof passes QA heuristics.
findings.userImpact: Off-brand deliverables.
findings.methodologyImpact: Distinctiveness goals under-enforced at asset level.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Vision QA hook on composed proof before founder review.
